test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97d514d84a7f3f6a8c22a4340ad562948799731c0649f01b64e8331fce7c7036.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: Symbol of "arrow" moves 45º in anticlockwise direction in each next image.

.Step II: Shaded portion of inside image moves 90º in clockwise direction in each next image.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3103ee9d21fb06f48109f02fcdf01dc91fa452ebc1aab43e1d8f482df712c76f.png] 

Thus, the complete series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15c3858673a8ebad5e1104d63858d6aa901f468be126a3fd595192e72436c4a3.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
